Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (FinCo Redwood evaluation)

Hi Marissa (and team),

Thanks again for the demo and the deep dive today — super helpful. A few follow ups from our side to keep the procurement thread moving: 

- Can you confirm current SOC 2 status and expected evidence delivery timeline? We need to know whether you have a completed report and whether it covers the controls relevant to data handling for financial services.
- We need to confirm how you handle GDPR data residency/processing and whether you provide a DPA.
- Does Redwood offer a BAA for HIPAA-covered data, or is that on the roadmap?
- We want to kick off your vendor security questionnaire (PDF attached on our side). Can you provide the preferred questionnaire intake flow (shared drive link / secure form / vendor portal)?
- Longer-term: can you share any roadmap notes for ISO 27001 and FedRAMP (our govt pilot may require FedRAMP later this year).

Next steps for us: I can circulate the questionnaire to our security team, but we wanted your answers first so we can prep. Please also include a security contact for follow-up.

Appreciate it — looking to move quickly here.

Best,
Jenna Ortiz
Head of Procurement, FinCo
jenna.ortiz@finco.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up (FinCo Redwood evaluation)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear recap and great questions. Recapping answers and next steps below: 

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: We are currently in the SOC 2 Type 2 readiness phase. Target: audit window Q3 2027 with report delivery in Q4 2027. We have interim controls and a summary doc attached (SOC2-external-summary.pdf) that outlines scope and control families. If you need in-flight evidence sooner, we can provide control mappings and select evidence packages under NDA.
- GDPR: We provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and support standard EU region hosting options for data residency. DPA attached (DPA.pdf).
- HIPAA: We do support HIPAA workflows and can execute a BAA for customers with covered workloads. This is an add-on and we'd be happy to share the standard BAA template.
- Vendor security questionnaire: Preferred flow is our secure questionnaire portal (link below) or we can take the attached PDF and populate answers on your behalf. For sensitive evidence we use a secure SharePoint/SFTP intake per customer preference.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please upload your questionnaire to our secure intake or reply to this thread with the PDF and we will begin populating answers (Lauren will own questionnaire responses).
2) If you want a technical deep dive, we can schedule a 60-min technical review with infra/research — suggested slots: Tue 1/19 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 1/20 14:00-15:00 PT.
3) If FedRAMP/ISO is material to your procurement decision, we can provide a roadmap & control mapping — see high-level notes below.

High-level roadmap notes:
- ISO 27001: Feasible to pursue; typical delivery for certification baseline is 9–12 months if prioritized.
- SOC scope expansion: We can accelerate scope to include additional control areas (e.g., change management, incident response evidence) with a focused readiness sprint (4–8 weeks of effort).
- FedRAMP: Not currently a certified offering; we can map controls to NIST 800-53 and support customers in either a dedicated/private deployment or a partner-ready package as a path to FedRAMP authorization (longer-term effort, 12+ months).

Security contact: security@redwood.com (primary), I am your direct point for this engagement (marissa.cole@redwood.com).

I attached: SOC2-external-summary.pdf, DPA.pdf (stubs). Let me know where to upload the questionnaire or if you'd prefer we complete the attached PDF.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2-external-summary.pdf (PDF stub); DPA.pdf (PDF stub)

Links:

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/FIN-2027-0034

Thanks Marissa — that is really helpful. We'll start the questionnaire this afternoon and route any evidence requests to your secure intake link. A few clarifying items from our security team:

- For SOC 2 evidence: if you can provide interim evidence packages (control mappings + samples) that would help our review before the final report arrives. Timeline: our procurement team needs final sign-off by end of Q2; if SOC 2 report is Q4 that may be a blocker unless we can accept interim evidence.
- ISO 27001: can you include a high-level estimate of cost/effort to pursue certification (we'll need a number for our procurement forecast).
- FedRAMP: we understand this is long-term but want to see a control-gap mapping to the extent possible.

Security contact here is security@finco.com — I'll share the questionnaire this afternoon. Appreciate you and Lauren coordinating the responses.

Best,
Jenna

Folks — forwarding the thread from FinCo. Key asks: interim SOC 2 evidence packages we can provide, ISO 27001 cost/effort number for procurement, and a control-gap mapping for FedRAMP.

Proposed plan: 
- Rishi: can you put together a rough timeline and level-of-effort estimate for accelerating SOC 2 scope and for ISO 27001 certification (ballpark cost + headcount/time)? We should include options: (A) standard readiness (9–12 months), (B) accelerated program (6 months, higher cost). Please include whether we can deliver interim evidence packages (e.g., control mapping + sample evidence) and what pre-conditions are needed (NDA, access to internal logs).
- Lauren: please own the questionnaire responses and start populating the attached FinCo PDF once they upload it; coordinate with infra for any evidence pulls. I'll add our SOC2-roadmap-outline.pdf (attached) as a working doc.
- I'll schedule a technical deep-dive with infra/research next week — tentative Wed 1/20 14:00 PT.

Notes for the response to FinCo: be explicit about what interim evidence looks like (control mapping, screenshots, configuration docs, operational logs) and the process to receive sensitive files (SFTP or secure intake). Also call out that FedRAMP is a longer runway but we can provide NIST 800-53 mappings.

Action items: Rishi (timeline + costing) by EOD Fri 1/21. Lauren (initial questionnaire draft) by Tue 1/19.

Thanks —
Marissa
